name: Habibur Comment Blocker
author: Habibur Rahman

sections.description:
Stop wrestling with messy comment sections and database bloat. Habibur Comment Blocker is a precision-engineered WordPress plugin designed to give site administrators absolute authority over their site’s engagement.

Unlike bulky alternatives, this plugin is built for speed, security, and simplicity. It effectively removes comment support, hides comment-related UI in the dashboard and admin bar, and prevents new comments or pingbacks from being submitted.

Why Choose Habibur Comment Blocker?

  • Stop Spam Instantly – Blocks unwanted engagement before it litters your site.
  • Enhance Site Performance – Lightweight code ensures zero impact on page loading speed.
  • Reduce Database Bloat – Keeps your database clean and fast by preventing junk data storage.
  • No Configuration Needed – Works right out of the box with an easy, user-friendly interface.
  • Security Focused – Adds a layer of protection against automated bot comments.
  • Developer-Grade Quality – Built following official WordPress.org coding standards.

Most comment plugins are heavy and complicated. Habibur Comment Blocker offers a simple “set it and forget it” solution. Built with clean code and native WordPress hooks, it keeps your site fast, secure, and professional—whether you run a small blog or a high-traffic business site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Comments are disabled automatically upon activation.
sections.faq:
Can I enable comments again?

Yes. Simply deactivate the plugin to restore standard WordPress comment functionality.

Does this delete existing comments?

No, it hides them from the front-end and prevents new ones. Your existing data remains safe in the database unless you choose to delete it manually.

Where can I get custom WordPress development help?

Visit https://habibur.net for professional WordPress development services.
